Historical full-card image of [[Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|Blaster Rack]], matching the later [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Historical PC full-card image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071218114356/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v1/ds/blasterrackv.gif Blaster Rack], swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 18 December 2007).
* Publisher slip and card text: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards1.pdf, page 2, card 09], Players Committee; official text as of 4 December 2006 (Internet Archive, 24 October 2007).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif</code>.
